notes.long: Both long-band boards retain softer long crossings than the exact target. The higher false-gap example looks close to the parent.
notes.same_band: The shorter family is slightly more coherent on the cedar example and still soft across the diagonal transition.
notes.natural: The island sky gradient is visually smooth. The woodland keeps soft leaves and edge detail close to the parent.
notes.main: The sky looks smooth and the coarse fence is coherent. Small leaves and building wires remain soft.
notes.fine_cab: Both noise profiles and both native exposures retain incomplete fine crossings. The right diagonal traces remain clearest under transferred conditioning.
